why: `prop?` asks about the shape of a node rather than about a value, so it is the only predicate that can answer *which holdings are still open* — the state eleven measured classes encode by leaving the end date off. It is a separate operator from the `>?` affix and not a spelling of it: the affix widens one comparison, this one takes no operand at all, and `ended??` is not a thing a caller can write. A missing key and a key holding nothing are the same condition here, which is the condition every other operator already treated identically by coming back false for both.
